claims: Recheck blood glucose and treat hyperglycemia (fingerstick 333 mg/dL) per insulin protocol.
Monitor and manage hyponatremia (sodium 125 mEq/L), including neurologic checks and reassessment of sodium and serum osmolality.
Reassess renal function and urine output given creatinine rise from 2.0 to 2.2 mg/dL and BUN 35 mg/dL.
Assess for bleeding and recheck hemoglobin/hematocrit given hemoglobin 10.6 g/dL and coagulation abnormalities (INR 1.5, PT 16.1 sec).
Monitor respiratory status and oxygenation, including BiPap settings and oxygen flow, given hypercapnia (pCO2 59 then 36 mmHg) and oxygen saturation 92-94%.
Continue hemodynamic monitoring and support (arterial line, vasopressor infusion) given hypotension (MAP 62-77 mmHg).
Recheck potassium and manage hyperkalemia (potassium 5.0 mEq/L) with ECG monitoring and potassium-lowering therapy as needed.
Perform medication reconciliation and review of active medications, including insulin, antihypertensives, and diuretics, in the context of renal dysfunction and electrolyte abnormalities.
Assess volume status and continue diuretic therapy as indicated (furosemide given) while monitoring electrolytes and renal function.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis (heparin subcutaneous) and assess bleeding risk.
